title: 北京
summary: 五一那三天。天安门的夜、故宫里的宝座和畅音阁，还有一碗豆汁。
summaryEn: Three days over the May Day holiday — Tiananmen after dark, the throne halls and the opera stage inside the Forbidden City, and a bowl of douzhi.
